北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，湿度大，感觉会有点闷，记得多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and humid. It might feel a bit stuffy, remember to hydrate!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云，体感 31℃。紫外线较强，出门记得做好防晒。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and feels 31℃. UV is strong, remember sun protection.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴热，体感 33℃。高温持续，记得多补充水分哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and feels hot at 33℃. Stay hydrated in this heat!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度 89%，体感闷热。注意除湿，保持舒适。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with 89% humidity, feeling stuffy. Keep cool and dry!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨，出门别忘带伞，路面湿滑，慢走慢行哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain. Don't forget your umbrella, and walk carefully!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 34℃，天气炎热，请注意防暑降温，避免中暑。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels 34℃, very hot. Please prevent heatstroke and stay cool.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴热，体感 34℃。阳光强烈，多喝水，小心晒伤哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels 34℃. Strong sun, stay hydrated and protect your skin.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天体感 33℃，湿度高。温差大，注意调整着装。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels 33℃ with high humidity. Mind indoor-outdoor temp changes.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗炎热，体感 35℃！记得防暑，多喝水，保护好自己。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and hot, feels 35℃! Remember to cool down, drink water, stay safe.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 36℃，天气非常热！请务必防暑，多休息，多饮水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels 36℃, extremely hot! Please prevent heatstroke, rest, and hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴热，体感 38℃！请减少户外活动，谨防中暑哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and feels 38℃! Limit outdoor activities, beware of heatstroke.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗舒适，气温 19℃，正是户外散步的好时候。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and pleasant at 19℃, perfect for a walk outside.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，气温 21℃，体感舒适。享受美好天气吧！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and comfortable at 21℃. Enjoy the lovely weather!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，气温 21℃，体感舒适。湿度大，注意衣物防潮。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and mild at 21℃. High humidity, mind your clothes' moisture.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，湿度 96%！请注意除湿，保持室内干爽舒适。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with 96% humidity! Please dehumidify and keep indoors dry and comfy.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，湿度 80%，体感微闷。海边风大，注意防风哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with 80% humidity, slightly stuffy. Wind is strong near the sea.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，湿度 90%，体感清凉。海边风力大，记得添衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with 90% humidity, feeling cool. Windy by the sea, layer up.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全，小心驾驶。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy with low visibility. Drive carefully and mind road safety.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴朗，体感 30℃，湿度高。紫外线强，注意防晒。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 30℃ with high humidity. Strong UV, mind the sun.
